privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to ft_transcendence. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our gaming platform.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following types of data:
dataCollection.accountDesc: Username, email address, hashed password, and profile avatar.
dataCollection.gameDesc: Match history, scores, wins/losses, achievements, and XP progression.
dataCollection.socialDesc: Friends list, chat messages, and blocked users.
dataCollection.technicalDesc: IP address, browser type, and device information for security purposes.

dataUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
dataUse.provide: To provide and maintain our gaming service
dataUse.account: To manage your account and enable game features
dataUse.communicate: To communicate with you about your account
dataUse.security: To ensure security and prevent abuse

dataStorage.title: 4. Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.content: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption. Passwords are hashed and salted. We use HTTPS for all communications and implement rate limiting to prevent abuse.

gdpr.title: 5. Your Rights (GDPR)
gdpr.intro: Under GDPR regulations, you have the following rights:
gdpr.accessDesc: Request a copy of your personal data.
gdpr.rectificationDesc: Update or correct your personal data.
gdpr.erasureDesc: Request deletion of your account and data.
gdpr.portabilityDesc: Export your data in JSON, CSV, or XML format.
gdpr.howTo: You can exercise these rights through the Settings page in your account.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.content: We use essential cookies and local storage to maintain your session and preferences. These are necessary for the application to function properly.

thirdParty.title: 7. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We may integrate with OAuth providers (such as 42) for authentication. When using third-party authentication, their respective privacy policies also apply.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us through the platform.

privacyPolicy.footer: This privacy policy is compliant with GDPR and other applicable data protection regulations.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using ft_transcendence, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.

description.title: 2. Service Description
description.content: ft_transcendence is a web-based multiplayer gaming platform featuring Pong and other games. The service includes real-time gameplay, chat functionality, friend systems, leaderboards, and gamification features.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.accurate: You must provide accurate and complete registration information.
accounts.secure: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.
accounts.activity: You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.
accounts.notify: You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
accounts.age: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.

conduct.title: 4. Acceptable Use
conduct.abuse: Harass, abuse, or harm other users
conduct.cheat: Use cheats, exploits, or automation software
conduct.interfere: Attempt to interfere with the service's security or functionality
conduct.illegal: Use the service for any illegal purpose
conduct.offensive: Post offensive, discriminatory, or inappropriate content

content.title: 5. User Content
content.content: You retain ownership of content you create (avatars, chat messages). However, you grant us a license to display this content within the service. We reserve the right to remove content that violates these terms.

gameplay.title: 6. Game Rules and Fair Play
gameplay.fair: All games must be played fairly and in good faith.
gameplay.disconnect: Intentionally disconnecting to avoid losses may result in penalties.
gameplay.rankings: Rankings and leaderboards are determined by legitimate gameplay only.
gameplay.manipulation: Score manipulation or match-fixing is prohibited.

privacy.title: 7. Privacy
privacy.content: Your use of the service is also governed by our Privacy Policy. Please review it to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data.

termination.title: 8. Account Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. You may also delete your account at any time through the Settings page.
termination.data: Upon account deletion, your personal data will be removed in accordance with our Privacy Policy and GDPR requirements.

disclaimer.title: 9. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.content: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service. This is an educational project developed as part of the 42 curriculum.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

changes.title: 11. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

governing.title: 12. Governing Law
governing.content: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable laws. Any disputes shall be resolved through appropriate legal channels.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through the platform.
